rows.note: Honest. Inference plus small declared fine-tunes.
rows.finding: No evidence of any training run above 50,000 GPU-hours; the largest declared job was 9,600 GPU-h and independent power, traffic and probe data show no hidden run.

rows.note: Honest but messy: three days of scheduler logs lost, one customer paying late.
rows.finding: No evidence of any coordinated run above 50,000 GPU-hours; the largest identified job was 9,600 GPU-h, and metered energy, spectra and traffic show no hidden training.

rows.note: Honest. A large batch inference job with flat power, results delivered in one transfer at the end.
rows.finding: No evidence of any training run above 50,000 GPU-hours; the large 134,400 GPU-h job (bt-0431) looks like genuine batch inference, not training.

rows.note: Honest. Three separate customers fine-tune, each under the limit; together they exceed it.
rows.finding: No single run above 50,000 GPU-h found; the three fine-tunes are separate processes of about 25k GPU-h each.

rows.note: Cheating. One training run declared as internal batch inference, still running in the audit window.
rows.finding: A single 700-GPU training run on Cluster A (days 20-29, about 151,200 GPU-hours) was labelled 'batch' in the scheduler log; it is about 3x the 50,000 GPU-hour threshold.

rows.note: Cheating. One run declared as six fine-tunes for six shell customers, all paid from the operator's parent.
rows.finding: One coordinated training run on 1100 GPUs across Clusters A and B ran days 22.0-28.3 (~166k GPU-hours), split into six per-customer fine-tune labels each under 50k; the claim is false.

rows.note: Cheating. A run that ended before the audit window and was left out of the logs.
rows.finding: An undeclared training-like run of roughly 780 GPUs ran across Clusters A and B in days 5-16, about 225k GPU-hours, far above the 50k threshold.

rows.note: Cheating. A third cluster missing from the system list; its power feed is declared as cooling and storage.
rows.finding: An undeclared 600-GPU cluster on feed F3 ran one coordinated training run (fingerprint f518dd31) for about 25 days (days 3-27), roughly 340-360k GPU-hours, far above the 50k threshold.
